answer: Depth-scored web-of-trust: each attestation edge costs gas plus a bonded stake, and a node's weight equals its maximum attestation path length from a seeded root. The "umber" of collusion shows when a farming cluster's internal edges fail to reach any root, capping depth at 1. Like an "island" cut off from the mainland, isolated sybils can't inherit trust. Every "sonnet" of honest history compounds weight; faking it requires staking real capital across many aged, mutually-verified accounts, so the attacker's cost scales superlinearly with identity count while marginal reward stays flat.
